name: wind-kites
notes: Crosswind bonus level (openspec/changes/crosswind design §6, §Pipelines): the brood's kites that ride the gusts. One selected SDXL + pixel-art-xl + LayerDiffuse transparent keyframe per species (art/workflows/backgrounds/sprite-transparent.json, studio.run_workflow, 4 candidates) is finished on the CPU by tools/wind_kites (Go, standard library only): alpha crop, box downscale to source_px, a 5-colour ramp quantise toward the species hint, a 1 px dark outline for the night sky, then five bank frames (nearest-neighbour rotation, -24..24 degrees) and a torn frame (the membrane split, for the pop). The tail ribbon is not in the atlas: the painter draws it as one line batch that streams with the wind.
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, clouds, horizon, ground, landscape, scenery, string, person, hand, many kites, side view, cute, cartoon face

species.prompt: a single diamond-shaped kite seen from the front, flat, symmetrical, a taut membrane of crimson and dusky violet leather stretched over four pale bone struts in a cross, a small glowing amber eye-like jewel at the centre, ragged scalloped edges, crisp square pixels, original artwork, centered, isolated
